title: SLI Definition
scope: ai-template workflow, API, and request logging surfaces
pii_policy: PII and secrets must not be emitted as metric labels, span attributes, or log fields.

slis.name: Governance Execution Completeness
slis.user_promise: Enterprise roadmap tasks can be audited from source documents and task evidence.
slis.good_event: A task execution has mandatory source review, scope, implementation notes, validation results, change list, and decision request recorded.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Evidence is file-based until metrics catalog implementation.

slis.name: Runtime Operation Success Rate
slis.user_promise: Runtime operations complete without controlled or uncontrolled failure.
slis.good_event: A runtime operation exits successfully and records success state.
expected_sources: Future trace spans for runtime operations.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Product instrumentation is not changed in W2-T1.

slis.name: Workflow Completion Rate
slis.user_promise: Business workflows that start can reach a terminal successful state.
expected_sources: Future trace spans for workflow execution.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Product instrumentation is not changed in W2-T1.

slis.name: API Request Success Rate
slis.user_promise: API requests receive successful, controlled responses.
slis.good_event: An API request returns a successful response class.
slis.total_event: Any API request received by the application surface.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Product instrumentation is not changed in W2-T1.

slis.name: Request Latency Distribution
slis.surface: ai-template API and workflow request handling
slis.user_promise: Requests complete within an observable latency distribution.
slis.good_event: Not applicable. This SLI is a distribution, not a pass/fail ratio.
slis.total_event: Any measured request, workflow, or orchestrator execution.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Product instrumentation is not changed in W2-T1.

slis.name: AI Provider Call Success Rate
slis.surface: AI provider and external API integration paths
slis.user_promise: External AI/provider calls return usable responses or controlled failures.
slis.good_event: An external provider call returns a usable response without retry exhaustion.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Product instrumentation is not changed in W2-T1.

slis.name: Retry Recovery Rate
slis.surface: ai-foundation retry and error handling paths
slis.user_promise: Retryable failures are recovered when retry policy can safely recover them.
slis.good_event: A retryable failure succeeds after one or more retries.
slis.total_event: Any retryable failure handled by retry logic.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Product instrumentation is not changed in W2-T1.

slis.name: Incident Capture Rate
slis.surface: ai-foundation and ai-template incident/error logging paths
slis.user_promise: High-severity failures produce durable diagnostic records.
slis.good_event: A high or critical failure creates a structured incident or diagnostic record.
slis.total_event: Any high or critical failure observed by error handling.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Product instrumentation is not changed in W2-T1.

slis.name: Observability Data Freshness
slis.surface: metrics, logs, traces, and governance evidence
slis.user_promise: Operational data is recent enough to support diagnosis and audit.
slis.good_event: An observability stream or evidence source has data newer than its configured freshness window.
slis.total_event: Any required observability stream or evidence source.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Freshness windows are deferred to W2-T2.

slis.name: Trace Correlation Coverage
slis.surface: runtime, workflow, API, and provider operations
slis.user_promise: Failures and slow paths can be correlated across request, workflow, runtime, and provider boundaries.
slis.good_event: An operation emits a correlation identifier and can be linked to logs or traces.
slis.implementation_status: Defined. Product instrumentation is not changed in W2-T1.
